scope: All 43 residual neobhod- necessity forms in the live v019 Latin reader: ten in 45-isv, 32 in base-papers1-43, and one bibliography title.
choice: Extend the accepted EDIT-0039 potrěbn-/potrěbno necessity policy to 25 nominal, adjectival, and predicative sites; resolve the other 18 contexts with explicit modal or inferential clauses so that not-necessarily scope and redundant double modals are not flattened.
motivation: Neobhodimy is an official type-1 word, but in this reader it duplicated the already selected pan-Slavic mathematical necessity family and preserved source-conditioned terminology variation. Direct replacement was appropriate for necessary conditions; it was not appropriate for must necessarily, not necessarily, or follows necessarily constructions. The split yields one searchable terminology family without changing logical scope.
alternatives_rejected: Keep neobhod- as a valid free synonym: this retains a second terminology family for the same necessary-condition concept and weakens corpus coherence.
Blindly replace every neobhodno with potrěbno: this produces awkward or scope-changing phrases such as ne morajut potrěbno and potrěbno mora.
Replace negative necessity with ne trěba: EDIT-0039 already established that this changes not-necessarily P into P is not needed.
Use neizběžno: inevitability is stronger than logical or modal necessity.

prior_policy.rule: Use official type-1 potrěbn-/potrěbno for mathematical necessity while preserving negation scope and repairing agreement.

official_dictionary.accepted_primary_entries: id 29955 potrěbno and id 1296 potrěbny, both type 1 and broad across East, West, and South

official_adjective_grammar.relevance: agreement of potrěbny forms and the potrěbno adverb/neuter predicate

german_meaning_authority.scope_distinctions: notwendig, nicht notwendig, notwendig und hinreichend, muß, and folgt notwendig were preserved as distinct constructions

independent_math_comparator_policy.finding: EDIT-0039 admitted potrěbn- by independent-language presence and official cross-family evidence rather than raw token counts.

validation.scope: necessary-and-sufficient conditions, not-necessarily clauses, necessary inference, and double-modal cases were separately asserted

validation.structure: TeX controls, labels/references/citations, braces, math delimiters, and line counts unchanged
